req.title: Task title trimmed of whitespace
req.statement: The system shall trim leading and trailing whitespace from the title on POST /tasks/.

doc.reasoning: R-TASK-037 requires that POST /tasks/ trims leading and trailing whitespace from the task title before persisting it. The test suite covers: (1) a positive EP case where a title with surrounding spaces is submitted and the stored title is the stripped version; (2) a negative NEG case where a title composed entirely of whitespace should fail validation (min_length=1 after stripping, or the raw string passes min_length but is semantically empty — we test the boundary where only spaces are sent); (3) a BVA boundary case where a single non-space character surrounded by spaces is submitted, verifying the trimmed result is exactly that one character; (4) a DT case combining leading-only whitespace; (5) a DT case combining trailing-only whitespace. Each test asserts the exact HTTP status code and the exact trimmed title value in the response body to maximise mutation kill rate.

tests.name: test_title_leading_and_trailing_whitespace_trimmed
actions: POST /tasks/ with title '   Buy milk   ' (leading and trailing spaces)
expected: Response JSON field 'title' equals 'Buy milk' (no surrounding spaces)
trace: R-TASK-037: system shall trim leading and trailing whitespace from title
tests.executable:
import os, sys
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite:///./test_r037_pos.db')
from app.database import engine, Base
Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_title_leading_and_trailing_whitespace_trimmed():
    payload = {"title": "   Buy milk   ", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    assert r.status_code == 201
    body = r.json()
    assert body["title"] == "Buy milk"
    assert "   " not in body["title"]
    assert body["title"].strip() == body["title"]

test_title_leading_and_trailing_whitespace_trimmed()

tests.name: test_title_only_whitespace_rejected_or_trimmed_to_empty
actions: POST /tasks/ with title '     ' (five spaces, no non-space characters)
expected: HTTP 4xx response (422 Unprocessable Entity) because after trimming the title is empty, violating min_length=1
No task is created with a blank title
trace: R-TASK-037: trimming whitespace-only title must not produce a valid empty title
tests.executable:
import os
os.environ.setdefault('DATABASE_URL', 'sqlite:///./test_r037_neg.db')
from app.database import engine, Base
Base.metadata.drop_all(bind=engine)
Base.metadata.create_all(bind=engine)
from app.main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)

def test_title_only_whitespace_rejected_or_trimmed_to_empty():
    payload = {"title": "     ", "completed": False}
    r = client.post("/tasks/", json=payload)
    # After trimming, title becomes '' which violates min_length=1 -> 422
    # OR if not trimmed, raw '     ' has length 5 which passes min_length=1
    # but requirement says trim MUST happen, so result must be 4xx
    assert r.status_code in (400, 422)
    # Confirm no task with blank/whitespace-only title was persisted
    list_r = client.get("/tasks/")
    assert list_r.status_code == 200
    titles = [t["title"] for t in list_r.json()]
    assert "     " not in titles
    assert "" not in titles

test_title_only_whitespace_rejected_or_trimmed_to_empty()
